| Schneider Electric iEM3155 (iEM3100/3200/3300 series) — Modbus map for Omni Console
| Modbus register list, cross-checked against a working field configuration.
| - Instantaneous values are FLOAT32 (f32), 2 registers, Big-Endian — the
| default — so `word_order` is omitted. Energy totals are 64-bit integers
| (s64, 4 registers, Big-Endian) in Wh. Read with FC03 (holding).
| - IMPORTANT addressing: the manual prints 1-based "register" numbers; the
| on-the-wire (PDU) address is register - 1. Addresses below are the 0-based
| PDU addresses that match how Omni Console issues reads (e.g. manual reg 3060
| "Total active power" -> address 3059). Power is reported in kW / kvar / kVA.
| - Factory defaults: device address (slave) = 1, RTU = 19.2 kbps, 8E1.
| - Additional energy registers (reactive/apparent, per-direction) exist in
| DOCA0005EN around manual reg 3220+ and can be appended as needed.
